items.source: By default, actual version values that appear in request mappings are considered supported, and use of this method is optional. However, if you prefer to use only explicitly configured, supported versions, then set detectSupportedVersions flag to false.
items.translation: 默认情况下，请求映射中出现的实际版本值被视为受支持，使用此方法是可选的。但是，如果您只想使用显式配置的受支持版本，则将 `detectSupportedVersions` 标志设置为 `false`。

items.source: If you prefer to use explicitly configured, supported versions only, set the detectSupportedVersions flag to false.
items.translation: 如果您只想使用显式配置的受支持版本，请将 `detectSupportedVersions` 标志设置为 `false`。

items.source: Whether the strategy is configured to detect supported versions. If this is set to false then addMappedVersion(String...) is ignored and the list of supported versions can be built explicitly through calls to addSupportedVersion(String...).
items.translation: 是否配置了该策略以检测支持的版本。如果将此选项设置为 `false`，则忽略 addMappedVersion(String...)，并且可以通过调用 addSupportedVersion(String...) 显式构建支持的版本列表。

items.source: Add to the list of supported versions to check against in ApiVersionStrategy.validateVersion(Comparable, HttpServletRequest) before raising InvalidApiVersionException for unknown versions.
items.translation: 在 ApiVersionStrategy.validateVersion(Comparable, HttpServletRequest) 中，将版本添加到支持的版本列表中，以便在针对未知版本抛出 InvalidApiVersionException 之前进行检查。
